**Plan, no edits made.**

`buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js) already has the full data, `owner` and `slow` included. `toTable()` in [format.js](src/format.js) only prints the four `COLUMNS`, by design.

So the approach:

1. In `cli.js`, check `argv` for `--json`.
2. If set, `JSON.stringify(buildRows(), null, 2)` instead of `toTable(...)`.
3. Leave `report.js` and `format.js` untouched — `--json` gets every field, the text table stays narrow.

Want me to make that edit?
